<thought>We need to locate the retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target molecule, yields the listed precursor pairs. The template corresponds to a Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons reaction, which in the forward direction forms an aliphatic carboxylic acid and a C‑C double bond while breaking a C‑P bond and a C‑O bond. Using the functional‑group list obtained earlier, we can query the template catalog for templates that form “aliphatic carboxylic acid” and “C‑C double bonds” and break the appropriate bonds. This should return the desired template, from which we can obtain its ID and then map the reaction SMILES to produce the required `mapped_rxn`.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_broken": null,
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
